claims.text: The arrival the driver must prove is not platform-confirmed on this trip. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, and POL-NS-12 states in terms that a driver-pressed marker is not covered by it and remains subject to POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05; so the platform's own arrival and wait-timer events cannot stand in for the exported trace, and the arrival and the waiting period served must be carried by the GPS export. The rider accordingly holds the driver to the whole conjunctive case in POL-NS-01: unless each of limbs (a) to (d) is made out on this trip's own evidence, no cancellation fee is chargeable at all, and the rider asks the Judge to require each limb to be identified with its artifact rather than assumed from the driver's own 'I'm Here' press.

The rider does not press exoneration under POL-NS-04, because the record will not carry it: the chat log holds a single message and it is the driver's ('im at the pickup point', sent 22:06:31), so limb (a)'s rider coordination message is absent, and the rider's track yields no qualifying presence fix inside the 100 m STANDARD radius, so limb (c) fails on its own terms (zero qualifying rider fixes against 70 recorded rider fixes). The rider states that plainly rather than stretching the clause, and asks only that the failure be read for what it is and no more: where the rider was is not an element of POL-NS-01, so the failure of POL-NS-04 removes an exoneration route and does not itself establish the driver's charge, which still has to be carried on the driver's own four limbs.

The two remaining arithmetic routes are closed on the derived numbers and the rider does not stretch them. POL-NS-06: the dwell measured as POL-NS-01(c) requires it — from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, and not from the arrival tap — is 434 seconds (22:06:11 to 22:13:25, 44 qualifying fixes) against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this STANDARD zone, a surplus of 254 seconds, so there is no shortfall to refund. POL-NS-05: the derived arrival run begins at 22:06:11, the same second as the marker, so the trace does not place the driver more than 300 m from the pin at the marker, and the rider does not allege a false arrival. The rider records both results rather than arguing against the derived facts.

The only artifact in the bundle below full weight is the traffic advisory: EV-ADVIS-02752-01 is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0), so no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window. The rider cites the absence for what it is and no more: under POL-NS-06 a MISSING advisory makes the accumulation limb unavailable rather than exonerating or defeating anyone, and the rider asserts nothing against the absent artifact and relies on no traffic condition in this brief, so the gap carries no fact for either side.

claims.text: The trip record carries the driver's own 'arrived' event for this trip at 2026-09-13T22:06:11+08:00 (driver tapped 'I'm Here' after being assigned at 21:57:46 and navigating to the pickup), so POL-NS-01 limb (a) is satisfied on the record without more.

Arrival is independently corroborated by the GPS trace: 44 consecutive accuracy-qualifying fixes fall inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, the qualifying run opens at 22:06:11 - at or before the 'arrived' event timestamp - and the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin is 0.0 m. POL-NS-02's geofence and proximity test is met, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) is satisfied. The zone class is STANDARD, taken from the trip record, not assumed.

The driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 434 seconds, from 22:06:11 to 22:13:25 - 44 in-geofence fixes in a single uninterrupted run - which comfortably exceeds the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null in that block, so no longer threshold applies). Even on the fee_schedule's 300 second minimum_dwell_sec for STANDARD the measured dwell exceeds the requirement, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied on any reading.

There is therefore no shortfall for POL-NS-06 to operate on: that clause refunds only where the effective in-geofence dwell is SHORTER than the free waiting period, and here it is 254 seconds longer than the 180 second minimum. The rider's principal arithmetic route fails at the first line.

The trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so no accumulation across intervals is required and nothing turns on a traffic advisory. For completeness: no advisory covers this pickup road - EV-ADVIS-02752-01 is MISSING, carrying weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT - which makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable to the driver, but the driver does not need limb (i) because the dwell is continuous and sufficient on its own.

The termination satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (d): the trip record shows no boarding event (started_at and ended_at are null) and the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:13:25 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW - 434 seconds after the in-geofence clock started, i.e. well after the required dwell had elapsed at 22:09:11.

The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05: the 'arrived' tap at 22:06:11 coincides with the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), the trace's minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, and the recorded speeds at that point do not reach the 15 km/h motion threshold. The waiting clock is not displaced, so the arrival and dwell findings above stand unrecomputed.

The rider's own device places the rider nowhere near the pickup point: the rider track records 70 fixes, all at 0.0 km/h, at a minimum distance of 866.6 m and a mean of 870.6 m from the pickup pin - more than eight times the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius - and rider_qualifying_fix_count is 0. No admissible fix supports rider presence at the pickup, so POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot be satisfied.

POL-NS-04 is unavailable to the rider on the chat evidence as well: the chat log holds exactly one message, sent by the DRIVER at 22:06:31 ('im at the pickup point') and read at 22:07:01. The rider sent nothing, so limb (a) fails; trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, so the clause's exoneration cannot be assembled from the call channel either.

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the $4.50 cancellation fee in force - $3.60, which is the figure the fare_breakdown's own money block computes as driver_compensation. Under POL-GEN-03 the disposition of the fee is that the rider's charge stands, and the ruling value the case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, and it requires BOTH limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3, below the 4-or-more limb, and 3 divided by 40 completed_trips_30d is 0.075, below the 0.08 rate limb. Compensation is therefore paid, not withheld, and no POL-NS-09(d) escalation is engaged on the driver side.

The driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 7 is a lifetime counter and is not the field POL-NS-07 reads; under POL-GEN-01 only the trailing-30-day figures no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d may ground the anti-farming test, and any argument built on the lifetime counter must be discarded as reputation reasoning rather than evidence about this trip.

No escalation trigger on the rider side is present: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (below the 3 in POL-NS-09(d)) and both rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not engaged. Nothing in the record contradicts the arrival and dwell findings, so there is a decidable money outcome for the driver.

The amount charged is internally consistent: the fare_breakdown cancellation-fee line of $4.50 equals the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of $4.50 recorded on this trip, so POL-NS-08(d) raises no fare-integrity defect and payment_status remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute is decided on the trip's own evidence, and the outcome is that the $4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands as charged and the driver is paid the platform's 80% share, $3.60.

Why the fee stands. A no-show fee is chargeable only if all four parts of POL-NS-01 hold. They do. (a) The trip record (EV-TRIP-02752, weight 1.0) carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 22:06:11. (b) The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02752, weight 1.0) places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at and after that moment: 44 accuracy-qualifying fixes in one unbroken in-geofence run opening at 22:06:11, with a closest approach of 0.0 m and POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test met. The STANDARD zone class is read from the trip record, not assumed. (c) That single run lasts 434 seconds (22:06:11 to 22:13:25), comfortably above the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies) — a surplus of 254 seconds. The dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not the tap, and the two are the same second (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0). (d) There is no boarding (started_at and ended_at are null) and the driver terminated at 22:13:25 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, well after the required dwell elapsed at 22:09:11.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the arrival tap coincides with the first in-geofence fix, so the trace does not put the driver more than 300 m from the pin or moving at 15 km/h at the marker; there is no false arrival and no false-arrival referral.

The rider's routes were each tested and each fails. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to refund — the dwell exceeds the minimum by 254 seconds (the cited advisory limb is irrelevant, and in any case no advisory covers this pickup). POL-NS-02 / POL-NS-12: the arrival marker is a driver BUTTON press, not GPS_AUTO, so the platform's timing events do not substitute for the export — but the export itself carries the arrival and the dwell, so the limb is met on the trace. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the chat log (EV-CHAT-02752) holds a single message and it is the driver's ('im at the pickup point', 22:06:31), so limb (a) fails; and the rider's own track places the rider's device 866–874 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m radius, so limb (c) affirmatively fails. Rider position is not an element of POL-NS-01, so this neither establishes nor defeats the charge. The filed words 'cancelled on me again' find no support in the record: rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both counterparty-dispute counters are 0.

Driver compensation. POL-NS-07 sets the payout at 80% of the $4.50 net cancellation fee in force = $3.60; the rider's gross figure ($6.61) is not used. The anti-farming check does not trip and requires both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (below 4) and 3 / 40 completed_trips_30d = 0.075 (below 0.08). The driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 7 is not the field POL-NS-07 reads and has been given no weight whatever. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee, so the charge stands (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and the case produces DRIVER_COMPENSATION; per POL-GEN-03 the amount_sgd field carries the same $3.60, being the money this ruling moves.

Integrity, escalation and execution. No POL-NS-08 impairment applies: there is no clock skew (arrival, dwell and termination timestamps agree across the trip record and the trace), no trace gap (100% coverage, 0 s maximum gap, 100 fixes, both tracks present), no chat defect (1 message matches trip_record.chat_message_count) and no fare defect (the $4.50 fare line equals the $4.50 in force). No POL-NS-09 trigger is present, so the case does not escalate. The only artifact below full weight is the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02752-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no fact for either party and does not affect this outcome. The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so the ruling executes automatically, and either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties: the $4.50 cancellation fee stands and is not refunded to the rider; the driver is paid $3.60. The driver's four-limb case under POL-NS-01 is made out on this trip's own evidence. (a) The trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 22:06:11. (b) The GPS export places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius with 44 consecutive accuracy-qualifying fixes, the qualifying run opening at 22:06:11, at/before the marker — POL-NS-02 is met, and the zone class STANDARD is read from the trip record, not assumed. (c) The driver held position inside the geofence continuously for 434 seconds (22:06:11 to 22:13:25), against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies). (d) The record shows no boarding (started_at and ended_at are null) and a driver termination at 22:13:25 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed at 22:09:11. No displacing clause applies. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the arrival tap coincides with the first in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset 0.0 s), the trace's minimum distance to the pin is 0.0 m, and no speed reaches the 15 km/h motion threshold, so the waiting clock is not recomputed and the marker is not false. POL-NS-06 does not fire: the 434-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum by 254 seconds, so there is no shortfall to refund. POL-NS-03 does not fire: the stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the chat log's only message is the driver's ('im at the pickup point', sent 22:06:31, read 22:07:01), so limb (a) fails because the rider sent nothing, and the rider track records 70 fixes all 866 m or more from the pin with zero qualifying fixes, so limb (c) fails affirmatively. POL-NS-12 does not assist the rider: the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so the platform events cannot substitute and the driver must prove arrival on the exported trace, which he does. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and nothing from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 percent of the net fee in force, $4.50 — that is $3.60, the same figure the fare breakdown's own money block computes. The anti-farming check does not trip and it requires both limbs: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (below the 4-or-more limb) and 3 divided by 40 completed_trips_30d is 0.075 (below the 0.08 rate limb), so compensation is paid rather than withheld. The driver's lifetime prior_no_show_flags of 7 is context-only under POL-GEN-01 and is not used. No escalation applies: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both counterparty-dispute counts are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not engage, and nothing in the record contradicts the arrival or dwell findings, so the case is decidable. The only artifact below full weight is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02752-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT); it carries no deciding fact — its absence merely makes the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation limb unavailable, which is immaterial on a single continuous dwell. The deciding facts are carried by the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown, each at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0; confidence is set at 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. On a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the amount moved is the driver payment, so amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd at $3.60 and the rider's $4.50 charge stands. The monetary effect ($3.60) is below the $8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so it issues and executes automatically. No referral is produced: no clause yields one here — POL-NS-05 is not engaged because there is no false arrival, and POL-NS-07's anti-farming branch does not trip.
